title: ET-Prune: Evidence-Aware Dynamic Budgeting for Visual Token Pruning in Text-Rich MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.01979v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of multimodal large language models, but a fixed token ratio is poorly matched to text-rich inputs. In OCR-centric tasks, decisive evidence can be a small number, label, or field whose relevance is specified by the question; indiscriminate pruning can erase that evidence while retaining visually salient but irrelevant regions. We present ET-Prune, a training-free framework that casts pruning as evidence allocation. It derives question-conditioned evidence from a decoder-side partial query-key block, safeguards text-like spatial regions, and converts evidence uncertainty and density into a sample-specific token floor. Three progressive middle-layer events then move the sequence toward this budget, retaining more tokens for diffuse or text-dense evidence and pruning concentrated evidence more aggressively. At the observed point estimates from one deterministic pass per configuration

translated_title: ET-Prune：面向文本密集型多模态大语言模型的证据感知动态视觉令牌剪枝
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01979v2 公告类型：交叉替换  摘要：视觉令牌剪枝降低了多模态大语言模型的推理成本，但固定的令牌比例与文本丰富的输入不匹配。在OCR为中心的任务中，决定性证据可能是一个小数字、标签或字段，其相关性由问题指定；不加区分的剪枝可能会抹除该证据，同时保留视觉上显著但无关的区域。我们提出了ET-Prune，一个免训练框架，将剪枝视为证据分配。它从解码器侧的部分查询-键块中推导出问题条件化的证据，保护类似文本的空间区域，并将证据的不确定性和密度转化为样本特定的令牌下限。三个渐进式中间层事件随后将序列推向该预算，为分散或文本密集的证据保留更多令牌，而更积极地剪枝集中证据。在每次配置的确定性单次传递中观察到的点估计上。
tldr: ET-Prune提出了一种免训练的动态令牌剪枝方法，通过证据感知分配和问题条件化保护，在OCR任务中自适应调整剪枝预算，避免丢失关键文本证据。
en_tdlr: ET-Prune proposes a training-free dynamic token pruning method that adapts pruning budgets via evidence-aware allocation and question-conditioned protection, preventing loss of critical textual evidence in OCR tasks.
